question: In which of the following countries did India win its first double team gold at the Chess Olympiad in September 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hungary**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• India won its first double team gold at the Chess Olympiad in September 2024 held in **Hungary**.
 
• This achievement marked a significant milestone for Indian chess, showcasing their dominance at an international level.
 
• The Chess Olympiad is a biennial chess tournament organized by FIDE, the international chess federation.
 
• India's teams performed exceptionally well, securing gold in both the open and women's categories.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Chess Olympiad**

 
 
• The Chess Olympiad is a biennial chess tournament in which teams from all over the world compete.
 
• It is organized by FIDE, the international chess federation, and includes both open and women's tournaments.
 
• The event serves as a platform for countries to showcase their best chess talents.
 
 
 
• **FIDE**
 
 
• FIDE stands for Fédération Internationale des Échecs or International Chess Federation.
 
• Founded in 1924, FIDE is responsible for overseeing international chess competitions and maintaining the official rules of chess.
 
• FIDE's motto is "Gens una sumus," which means "We are one people."
 
 
 
• **Team Composition**
 
 
• Each team in the Chess Olympiad typically consists of four players and one reserve.
 
• Teams compete in a series of rounds, with points awarded for wins and draws.
 
• The team with the highest points at the end of the tournament wins the gold medal.
 
 
 
• **India's Chess Achievements**
 
 
• India has been steadily rising in the world of chess, with several players achieving international recognition.
 
• Notable Indian chess players include Viswanathan Anand, who is a former World Chess Champion.
 
• India's success at the Chess Olympiad highlights the country's growing prominence in the global chess community.
